function.description: Record an interaction with a person. Captures free-form notes plus structured needs and wants so they can be retrieved later by any AI agent via getRelationshipContext.

parameter.android:description: Full name or identifier of the person you interacted with
Free-form notes about what was discussed
What this person needs from you or others right now
What this person wants — aspirations, preferences, wishes
Unix epoch milliseconds of the interaction; defaults to now

return-value.android:description: JSON confirmation with interactionId and personId

function.description: Return the full relationship context for a person: contact details, complete interaction history, aggregated needs and wants. Ideal for answering questions like "What did I last talk to X about?" or "What does my contractor need from me?"

parameter.android:description: Full name or identifier of the person to look up

return-value.android:description: JSON object with person profile and interaction history
